recentItems.title: TRUMP'S POWER GAME OVER? | US Midterm Elections 2026 Explained | H-1B Visas, Tariffs & Global Impact
recentItems.description:
#idreamnews #idreamupdates #idreammediainterviews #teluguinterviews 
TRUMP'S POWER GAME OVER? | US Midterm Elections 2026 Explained | H-1B Visas, Tariffs & Global Impact
#donaldtrump  #usmidtermelections  #trumpnews  #uspolitics  #sureshkochattil 

In this episode of iDream News Beyond Headlines, senior journalist Suresh Kochattil joins host Kavitha to analyse the growing political challenges facing Donald Trump and the possible consequences if the Democrats gain control of the US Congress.

Will Trump lose control of the House of Representatives? Could the Senate also turn against him? What happens to Trump's policies if Democrats gain control of Congress? Will he become a lame-duck president?

The discussion explores Trump's declining approval ratings, rising cost of living, tariffs, immigration policies, healthcare costs, the Iran conflict, Israel, Netanyahu, and the global political consequences of the US midterm elections.

Key topics discussed:

Donald Trump and the 2026 US Midterm Elections

Can Democrats take control of the US Congress?

Will Trump become a lame-duck president?

Trump's approval ratings and growing political challenges

Iran war and its impact on Trump's political future

Trump, Israel and Benjamin Netanyahu

US tariffs and their impact on the global economy

H-1B visa and Green Card policies

Impact on Indian IT companies and Indian professionals

What could happen to India if Trump's political power weakens?

US politics and the road to the 2028 Presidential Elections

Watch this detailed political analysis to understand how the US midterm elections could reshape American politics and influence India and the rest of the world.

Show: iDream News Beyond Headlines
Host: Kavitha
Guest: Senior Journalist Suresh Kochattil
